sub_indicators.label: Land register
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.registry
sub_indicators.norm_short: The AU Framework and Guidelines on Land Policy asks for land rights, customary tenure included, to be registered and tracked in a computerised land information system with public access.
criteria: A source from the past three years says land rights are recorded on paper or not recorded.
Titles are being digitised or a digital cadastre or land information system is under way in some areas.
A digital title register, cadastre or land information system is in service for part of the country.
The digital land register is in service nationally or in all land offices.
Land searches, title applications or transfers can be made online.

gaps.4: No source found since October 2023 says land can be searched or registered online.
gaps.3: No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country.
gaps.2: No source found since October 2023 says: is a digital land register in service.
gaps.1: No source found since October 2023 says: is digital land registration under way.

ladder.empty: Nothing found says how land rights are recorded.
ladder.unplaced: Nothing found since October 2023 says whether land rights are registered digitally.
